# SaucerPay

Invoice escrow on Hedera testnet for HBAR and HTS tokens.

- Scaffold: npm create scaffold-hbar@latest --template BikramBiswas786/saucerpay
- Chain: Hedera Testnet (296)
- Contract: 0xd955a0ADe4a5EC4AA95422D2D7650749A2fe1db3
- Agent manifest: GET /api/agent/manifest
- Pricing: GET /api/quote
- Token metadata: GET /api/hedera/token?id=0.0.x
- Account map: GET /api/hedera/account?evm=0x
- HCS receipts: POST /api/hedera/receipt

Rules for agents:
- Never commit secrets.
- Pay invoices with the exact on-chain amount.
- A MetaMask key with no Hedera 0.0.x account cannot send.
